limitations: Published regional sediment map; not crab habitat observations.
Do not infer food, shelter, seagrass, C1 occurrence or survival from sediment alone.
Unmapped areas are unknown; broad polygons do not establish metre-scale substrate detail.
Publisher catalogue states 1:50,000 mapping scale, sampling and grain-size analysis; scale is not a per-point accuracy guarantee.
Per-polygon survey dates and local thematic accuracy remain unverified; catalogue update dates are not survey dates.
Catalogue lists Creative Commons Attributions without a licence version; preserve DMR attribution.

catalogueMetadata.verificationMethod: Read publisher catalogue and followed its ArcGIS resource link to the service used in this app
catalogueMetadata.collectionMethod: Dredge sampling; sediment grain-size analysis; classification according to Shepard (1954)
catalogueMetadata.note: Catalogue dates are not per-polygon survey dates or proof the live service is an exact dated release.
